label: pjm 27 reserve withholding
definition: REJECTED PROBE. pjm_26 keeper config + as_reserve_withholding (withhold the measured ~3 GW RT Primary Reserve requirement from the gas/oil energy stack and re-solve). Result: ~inert on energy LMP (Jul/Aug residual 2024 -8.82->-8.81; hours>$75 still 0; full-year p50 preserved; volumes unchanged). Top-of-merit withdrawal lands on idle peaker/oil headroom, so online reserve only thins 15->14 GW (still ~5x the requirement). The $75-200 afternoon residual is the opportunity-cost reserve regime, which needs AS co-optimization, not a headroom haircut. pjm_26 stays the keeper.
